findings.problem: Snapshot-derived inputs do not apply exclusion_rules before assigning inspected state. Actual capture_workspace classifies generated report Markdown as documentation, so a generated report becomes a source component and pin_inventory_sources requests it from Git.
findings.repair: Apply the same configured output/evidence/authored exclusion semantics to snapshot-derived inputs. Retain truthful excluded accounting and rationale; do not create a component, digest, or Git request for excluded output. Preserve accepted loader and coverage-rule behavior.
findings.verification: Add an in-memory ordinary capture_workspace case with an existing generated report/acceptance document under the artifact root. Confirm excluded accounting, absence of components/Git requests for the output, and guarded first/repeated publication without broadening source scope.

findings.problem: The trusted reader identity is verified before missing blobs are read but never after those reads. A reader changing checkout during the final read returns an apparently valid captured workspace.
findings.repair: Recheck the repository identity after the bounded immutable reads and reject a changed id/revision before returning the enriched capture.
findings.verification: Add a fake reader that returns the correct last blob then changes checkout identity. Require an actionable failure; preserve stable-reader and existing-object reuse behavior.

findings.problem: The entry budget is checked only when popping visited paths and separately per directory. A profile limit of four permits seven queued paths before rejection; larger trees can allocate a frontier proportional to the square of the configured budget.
findings.repair: Enforce an aggregate discovered/pending-entry bound before enqueueing further paths, with duplicate and overlapping-root handling consistent with deterministic traversal. Preserve early exclusion pruning and truthful frontier accounting.
findings.verification: Add a branching-tree fake whose individual directories each fit the limit but whose aggregate frontier exceeds it. Assert rejection before the pending/discovered budget is exceeded, with unchanged deterministic duplicate/root behavior.
